articles.headline: India Imposes 162.5% Duty on Bulk Scotch Imports
articles.brief: India plans to charge bulk Scotch imports a hefty 162.5% duty and tax amid a brewing trade pact standoff with the United Kingdom, presenting fresh hurdles for international beverage companies trying to expand their footprint in the lucrative South Asian market.

articles.headline: Gold Plummets to 14-Month Low on Strong Dollar
articles.brief: Gold prices dropped to a 14-month low as the surging U.S. dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured bullion demand. The sharp correction followed hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials signaling a firmer stance on interest rates.

articles.headline: Tanker Sunk Off Bulgaria Struck by Projectiles
articles.brief: An LPG tanker that sank off the coast of Bulgaria was confirmed to have been hit by projectiles, raising immediate international security concerns regarding maritime navigation routes and escalating regional conflict dynamics in the Black Sea.

articles.headline: Ford Ships First Battery Cells Using CATL Tech
articles.brief: Automotive giant Ford has officially shipped its first batch of battery cells utilizing cutting-edge CATL technology, marking a crucial milestone in its electrification strategy and supply chain diversification efforts.

articles.headline: Governments Issue Urgent Warning Over Critical Java Flaw
articles.brief: Global cybersecurity agencies issued severe warnings after discovering a critical vulnerability in widespread Java software, leaving major enterprise computer systems vulnerable to hostile intrusions and malicious cyber attacks.

articles.headline: Los Angeles Issues Mudslide Alerts Amid Atmospheric River
articles.brief: Southern California authorities issued urgent evacuation warnings for parts of Los Angeles as a powerful atmospheric river slammed the coast, threatening dangerous mud and debris flows across recent wildfire burn scars.

articles.headline: Trump Administration Unveils National Cybercrime Initiative
articles.brief: The Trump administration launched a sweeping federal initiative aimed at dismantling offshore cybercriminal syndicates responsible for a surge in sophisticated financial frauds and cryptocurrency scams targeting American citizens.

articles.headline: Hakeem Jeffries Nominated as First Black House Speaker
articles.brief: Congressional Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House, putting him on a historic path to become the first Black American to hold the prominent leadership post ahead of the upcoming legislative term.

articles.headline: India Seeks 20% Capital Expenditure Hike for Defense
articles.brief: India's Ministry of Defense has formally requested a substantial 20% increase in its upcoming capital expenditure outlay to accelerate domestic military modernization programs and upgrade strategic defense infrastructure.

articles.headline: Security Forces Eliminate Kashmir's Last Active Local Terrorist
articles.brief: In a major counter-terrorism milestone, security forces neutralized Mohammad Lateef Bhat, the last remaining active local militant in Kashmir, following an intensive operation in the Kulgam district.

articles.headline: India Win Toss, Opt to Field Against New Zealand
articles.brief: India elected to field first after winning the toss in the opening Test match against New Zealand, capitalizing on favorable pitch conditions that traditionally aid pace bowlers during the initial days of the encounter.

articles.headline: India's CSR Spending Leaves Critical Gaps in Healthcare
articles.brief: A new impact report reveals that corporate social responsibility funding in India largely overlooks chronic non-communicable diseases outside of cancer, exposing severe gaps in national health and water security investments.

articles.headline: Milk Prices Rise Across India Despite Winter Flush
articles.brief: Milk prices across India have climbed further, placing an added financial strain on household budgets as structural supply constraints continue to affect the dairy sector despite the arrival of the traditional winter flush season.

articles.headline: India Leaving Out Mohammed Siraj for First NZ Test
articles.brief: The Indian team management left out senior fast bowler Mohammed Siraj, opting instead for a four-man pace attack featuring Jasprit Bumrah and debutants in the opening Test against New Zealand.

articles.headline: Study Highlights Surge in Non-Communicable Disease Deaths
articles.brief: Public health metrics indicate that non-communicable diseases now account for 60% of total deaths in India, up significantly from previous decades, prompting urgent calls for diversified medical funding and localized preventative strategies.
